bosses.name: The Inferno
bosses.role: Giant infected juggernaut: molten seams open in its chest between attacks.
bosses.entry: stand-off at 30 m; it walks, never runs
bosses.attackNote: every attack has a 0.8 s wind-up you can brake out of

phases.name: Molten Walk
attacks: sweeping arm slam (2.5 m)
ember spit: 3 slow fireballs

phases.name: Vent
attacks: chest vents open for 6 s — weak point ×3
lava trail follows its feet

phases.name: Overheat
attacks: enraged: double slam, embers become a ring
arena starts burning from the edges

bosses.name: Railmaw
bosses.role: A worm that lives under the ballast and wears the track as teeth.
bosses.entry: burrows ahead, surfaces behind the train
bosses.weakness: teeth ring: shoot the mouth during the coil
bosses.attackNote: it never attacks from the front — watch the sides

phases.name: Coil
attacks: bursts from the ballast beside the track
rail-shard volley, 5 shards in a fan

phases.name: Squeeze
attacks: coils across the track, blocks the lane for 4 s
telegraph: rails bend before it rises

phases.name: Collapse
attacks: digs under and takes the track with it — forced brake
spawns 4 crawlers from the hole

bosses.name: Slagheart
bosses.role: Walking furnace: the grate is the weak point, and it knows it.
bosses.entry: strides in from a side street, slower than it looks
bosses.attackNote: slag rain is telegraphed by the chimney glowing white

phases.name: Bellows
attacks: stomp shockwave (4 m)
vent bursts: 4 flame jets on a timer

phases.name: Stoke
attacks: opens the grate core — ×4 damage for 4 s, then it slams shut
chimney drops slag rain

phases.name: Meltdown
attacks: core exposed permanently but it chases at double speed
leaves a lava pool wherever it stands

bosses.name: The Conductor
bosses.role: Undead stationmaster with a signal lamp; calls trains that were never built.
bosses.entry: stands on the platform; the fight starts when the signal turns red
bosses.weakness: lamp staff arm — break it to stop the blind
bosses.attackNote: the semaphore never lies: red means move

phases.name: Timetable
attacks: semaphore arm signals which lane is safe
summons a ghost train that runs the opposite lane

phases.name: Delay
attacks: lamp staff blinds a gun slot for 4 s
husks rise from the platform

phases.name: Last Call
attacks: switches the tracks under you — forced A/B pick
attacks twice as fast, stops signalling

bosses.name: Glacier Maw
bosses.role: A jaw the size of a tunnel, with icicle teeth that regrow every phase.
bosses.entry: blocks the canyon mouth; you have to break in
bosses.weakness: between plates at the jaw hinge
bosses.attackNote: frost breath is a 1 s inhale — brake out of the cone

phases.name: Bite
attacks: lunges the width of the track
frost breath cone that freezes the nearest turret

phases.name: Shell
attacks: ice plates: 3 plates, 1 breaks per 400 damage
falling icicles from the ceiling

phases.name: Thaw
attacks: armour gone, speed doubled
the floor becomes slick — braking is halved

bosses.name: Rime Engine
bosses.role: A train like yours, grown over with ice and aimed the wrong way.
bosses.arena: head-on duel on a single track
bosses.entry: the mirror fight: it comes at you on your own rails
bosses.weakness: the headlight — shoot it to blind its aim
bosses.attackNote: it mirrors your speed: brake and it overshoots

phases.name: Head-on
attacks: rams — the only way out is a side branch
side turrets fire in sync with yours

phases.name: Boiler Burst
attacks: vents steam that hides the track for 3 s
drops ice caltrops behind it

phases.name: Derail
attacks: loses a wheel, drifts across both lanes
turret fire becomes a continuous beam

bosses.name: Mireheart
bosses.role: Fungal colossus; its cap breathes spore clouds that hide the horde.
bosses.arena: swamp clearing, water on both sides
bosses.entry: rooted at first; it pulls itself free at 70 %
bosses.attackNote: spore clouds do not damage — they hide; shoot blind into them

phases.name: Rooted
attacks: spore clouds: 4 clouds that hide enemies
tendril sweep across the track

phases.name: Uproot
attacks: walks on roots, spawns 2 spitters per 10 s
acid rain pools on the rails

phases.name: Bloom
attacks: cap bursts: 8 spore mines
tendrils grab the train and hold it for 2 s

bosses.name: Hollow Queen
bosses.role: A sac on legs that births swarmlings until you break the eggs.
bosses.arena: nest of egg sacs on the track
bosses.entry: the nest is already on the track; she is inside it
bosses.weakness: eggs — they are the real health bar
bosses.attackNote: she cannot move; the danger is the swarm

phases.name: Brood
attacks: births 3 swarmlings every 5 s
shell hardens while birthing (×0.5 damage)

phases.name: Rupture
attacks: sac bursts — 6 mites, shell softens ×1.5
web slows the train in a 10 m patch

phases.name: Last Eggs
attacks: guards 3 eggs; each egg killed removes a swarm wave
body attacks with 4 arms

bosses.name: Iron Choir
bosses.role: Three bell-torsos on one frame: kill them in order or the dead one sings.
bosses.entry: three torsos on one frame, singing in tune
bosses.weakness: the chain links between torsos (breaks the sync)
bosses.attackNote: listen for which bell rings first

phases.name: Three Voices
attacks: each torso has its own attack pattern: left shockwave, middle beam, right swarm
kill order is left → right → middle

phases.name: Discord
attacks: a dead torso keeps attacking for 8 s unless the next is killed fast
bells ring: screen shake, aim drifts

phases.name: Silence
attacks: last torso absorbs the others: bigger, faster, all three patterns
the frame collapses, arena narrows

bosses.name: The Nightmail
bosses.role: A ghost locomotive that phases through the swamp — and through you.
bosses.entry: it phases through the trees and arrives behind you
bosses.weakness: the headlight lanterns — break both to stop the phasing
bosses.attackNote: the illusion never touches the rails

phases.name: Phantom
attacks: phases out for 2 s, untargetable, then reappears beside the train
lantern beams that burn the nearest gun slot

phases.name: Twin
attacks: splits into two: one is an illusion — the real one casts a shadow
ghost rails force an A/B choice mid-fight

phases.name: Terminus
attacks: stops phasing, opens both boilers
chain lightning across the wagons, 3 s telegraph
